text:
alex: Heads-up — I need new GCP projects and quota increases. Two projects: `research-staging` (evals/fine-tune) and `prod-inference` (beta customers). Asking for accelerators + TPU cores + network quotas. Can someone help with project approval and quota raise?

maria: quick q — what are the exact numbers / regions and brief justification? security review needed for prod.

alex: sure. summary: 
- prod-inference: us-west1 L4 accelerators x40 (realtime inference, ~500 qps peak, <100ms p99 target). need static egress ips x20 for customers + VPC peering to partner network.
- research-staging: us-central1 TPU v4 core quota ~64 cores for large batch evals.
- europe: europe-west4 H100 x12 for mixed training/eval.
Estimated bill ~ $45k/mo for baseline steady-state, burst costs higher. Justification: prod needs predictable latency and redundancy across regions; staging needs TPU capacity for eval throughput.

cheng: notes — in GCP console the quota is listed under "Accelerator (GPUs)" per region. For TPUs request "TPU v4 cores". Also request external IPs (STATIC_ADDRESSES) and VPC_PEERING capacity. We'll need billing account linked and org admin approval on project creation.

sean: pls open the internal quota request form and copy the exact names GCP expects. link: https://go.redwood/gcp-quota-form 
Also check you have the Compute Engine API + TPU API enabled on the projects.

emma: to inspect current quotas run:
```bash
# check project-level quotas
gcloud compute project-info describe --project=PROJECT_ID
# check regional quotas (accelerators listed under region)
gcloud compute regions describe us-west1 --project=PROJECT_ID
```
If you want a single accel count, include both the per-region "accelerator" line and the global "GPUS"/"TPU" entries in the form.

alex: thanks — I filled the internal form and attached the workload calc + PRD: https://go.redwood/prd/prod-inference (shared). Filed with GCP case reference TBD.

infra-bot: Created JIRA ticket INFRA-2348 and opened GCP support case 987654321 for quota increases. Assigned to cheng.

cheng: I'll ping our TAM and request expedited review for us-west1 and europe-west4. Suggest we ask a bit higher than needed to avoid repeated requests: request L4 x60 in us-west1 (explain distributed autoscaling), H100 x16 in europe-west4, TPU v4 cores 80 in us-central1. Include fallback to preemptible instances in justification.

maria: +1 on buffering the request. Approving project creation for `prod-inference` once billing is attached and security does the checklist. Tagging @emma for sec review.

alex: billing account linked (billing-REDFIELD-01). Added service perimeter notes and compliance doc. I've pasted the workload spreadsheet in the JIRA ticket. Thanks all :thumbsup: 

emma: will start the security review today, expect a short checklist. If we need additional org IAM, call out the exact roles.

alex: will update INFRA-2348 with roles and IAM list. leaving this thread for updates there.
